While modern computer vision enables accurate human detection and pose estimation on Earth, its robustness in space environments remains largely unquantified due to limited data availability. We present AstroPIE-53, a pilot dataset of 53 annotated astronaut videos collected from publicly available mission footage. To respect copyright restrictions, we release video identifiers, reconstruction scripts, and dense annotations rather than raw videos. The dataset includes bounding boxes, challenge classes, and human-annotated pose failure tags. We benchmark state-of-the-art person detection and pose estimation models under realistic zero-shot deployment conditions and perform the first systematic failure analysis for astronaut monitoring. Our results reveal substantial performance degradation caused by occlusions, unusual body orientations, low contrast, and microgravity motion patterns.
tldr: 发布53段航天员视频数据集AstroPIE-53，系统评估太空环境下人体姿态估计的零样本失效模式。
motivation: 太空任务中航天员可靠监测对安全、态势感知和自主辅助至关重要，但现有地球场景视觉模型在太空环境中的鲁棒性因数据稀缺而缺乏量化。
method: 构建AstroPIE-53飞行员数据集，包含53段公开任务视频的标注；因版权限制仅发布视频标识、重建脚本与密集标注（边界框、挑战类别、人工姿态失败标签）。在真实零样本部署条件下基准测试先进人体检测与姿态估计模型，并开展首个面向航天员监测的系统失效分析。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但报告先进模型性能显著下降，主要失效由遮挡、异常身体朝向、低对比度和微重力运动模式引发。
conclusion: 该工作揭示太空环境下人体姿态估计的关键失效模式，为航天员监测模型的鲁棒性评估与后续改进提供数据和基准。

title: See the Lives of Stars in a Handful of Light
abstract: Galaxies evolve over hundreds of millions of years, and no telescope has ever watched one move. Cosmological simulations make this evolution visible as a sequence of multi-view images, inviting the question of whether a galaxy can be recovered in four dimensions from its images. This setting defeats existing dynamic scene methods, since millions of stars span only a few pixels each, faint populations blend into diffuse light, and free deformations reproduce the images without obeying gravity. We present Cosmos4D, which rests on two components. Gravitational 4D Gaussian Splatting represents each star as a self-luminous Gaussian whose motion is integrated through a gravitational potential and a low-dimensional force field shared by all stars. Luminosity-stratified dynamics give bright stars individual orbits supervised across image scales and carry faint populations with a velocity field estimated from optical flow. We further build a 4D dataset of eight galaxies from four cosmological simulations, on which Cosmos4D outperforms dynamic Gaussian baselines in both photometric quality and physical accuracy. With these advancements, we glimpse eight hundred million years of a galaxy's life in ninety-six frames.
tldr: Cosmos4D 用引力约束的4D高斯泼溅从多视角图像重建星系演化。
motivation: 星系演化跨越数亿年，望远镜无法直接观测其运动；宇宙学模拟以多视角图像序列呈现演化，引出能否从图像四维重建星系的问题。现有动态场景方法难以处理数百万颗仅占少数像素的恒星、弥散暗弱星族，且自由变形虽拟合图像却不遵守引力。
method: 提出 Cosmos4D：引力4D高斯泼溅将每颗恒星表示为自发光高斯，其运动通过引力势与所有恒星共享的低维力场积分得到。亮度分层动力学让亮星拥有可跨图像尺度监督的个体轨道，并用光流估计的速度场带动暗弱星族；同时构建来自四个宇宙学模拟、包含八个星系的4D数据集。
result: 在八个星系的数据集上，Cosmos4D 在光度质量与物理精度上均优于动态高斯基线；以96帧呈现星系约8亿年的生命历程。
conclusion: 表明引力约束与亮度分层动力学可从图像中恢复星系的四维演化，为观测不可及的星系演化提供可视化与物理一致的重建途径。

title: acuSimNet: Multi-View Self-Occlusion-Awared Visibility Learning for Cranio-Cervical Acupuncture Points
abstract: The localization of acupuncture points (acupoints) in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) presents unique challenges since they are defined by abstract principles rather than distinct anatomical landmarks. Existing approaches are typically constrained to single view or rely on indirect calculations of relative positions with respect to other landmarks, thereby overlooking human anatomical variations. Furthermore, acupoint visibility assessment, which determins whether points are occluded by human itself, hair, clothing, or other objects, has received limited attention in practical applications. Acupoint localization itself does not require 3D reconstruction, but inferring their occlusion relationships with anatomical surfaces does, which adds computational cost and limits real-time inference. In this work, we introduce acuSimNet, an efficient hierarchical multi-task learning architecture for multi-view, self-occlusion-aware visibility prediction of acupoints, achieving 99.97% accuracy on the validation set. Our approach also addresses the challenges of high-dimensional classification (174 acupoints in cervicocranial region), negative convergence issues for visible acupoints, and inter-task scheduling optimization, resulting in substantially accelerated convergence. We improved the training efficiency from the exisiting methods of 3000 epochs to achieve 99% validation accuracy, to our optimized framework achieving 90% accuracy in 39 epochs and 99% accuracy in 86 epochs. This architecture overcomes the limitations of existing methods, could enable practical applications in acupoints detection and visualization, advancing the automation of TCM.
tldr: 提出acuSimNet，多视角自遮挡感知预测颈颅穴位可见性，验证准确率达99.97%并大幅加速收敛。
motivation: 颈颅部穴位由抽象原则定义而非清晰解剖标志，现有方法多限于单视角或依赖相对位置间接计算，忽略人体解剖差异；同时穴位是否被人体、头发、衣物等遮挡的可见性评估关注不足。穴位定位本身不需三维重建，但推断其与解剖表面的遮挡关系需要三维信息，带来计算开销并限制实时推理。
method: 提出acuSimNet，一种高效的分层多任务学习架构，用于多视角、自遮挡感知的穴位可见性预测。该方法针对174个颈颅部穴位的高维分类、可见穴位的负收敛问题以及任务间调度优化进行设计，从而加速模型收敛。
result: 在验证集上达到99.97%的准确率；训练效率显著提升，从现有方法需3000个epoch达到99%验证准确率，优化框架仅需39个epoch达到90%、86个epoch达到99%准确率。
conclusion: 该架构克服了现有方法在单视角、间接定位和遮挡评估方面的局限，可支持穴位检测与可视化的实际应用，推动中医自动化发展。

title: SemLite-GS: Semantic-Selective Parallel Gaussian Splatting for Lightweight Building Reconstruction from UAV Oblique Imagery
abstract: Lightweight 3D building models support urban spatial analysis, but their production often requires dense scene reconstruction, building extraction, and mesh simplification. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is more efficient than conventional multi-view stereo, existing large-scale methods lack semantic selection and parallel instance-level training. We present SemLite-GS, a building-centric framework that reconstructs lightweight building meshes from large-scale UAV oblique imagery. First, an orthographic reference map establishes globally consistent building identities, which are propagated to oblique views to form camera-instance pairs and regions of interest. Second, semantic-selective parallel PGSR training jointly processes multiple pairs within relevant image regions while updating only target Gaussians; contextual Gaussians remain fixed to preserve visibility. Third, architectural planes extracted from rendered depth, opacity, and normal maps guide signed distance field optimization, producing meshes with adaptive polygon allocation and well-defined structural boundaries. Experiments on multiple large-scale UAV datasets demonstrate that our SemLite-GS substantially reduces building reconstruction time compared with representative full-scene 3DGS methods. With comparable polygon budgets, SemLite-GS achieves superior preservation of dominant planar structures and sharp architectural transitions compared with conventional dense reconstruction followed by mesh decimation. The source code is available at https://github.com/IRIS-LAB-whu/SemLite-GS.
tldr: SemLite-GS通过语义选择与并行PGSR训练，从无人机倾斜影像高效重建轻量建筑网格。
motivation: 轻量建筑模型支撑城市空间分析，但传统流程需密集重建、建筑提取与网格简化，效率较低；现有大规模3DGS方法缺乏语义选择与实例级并行训练。
method: 先用正射参考图建立全局一致的建筑身份并传播至倾斜视图，形成相机-实例对与感兴趣区域；再以语义选择式并行PGSR仅更新目标高斯、固定上下文高斯，并利用渲染深度、不透明度与法线提取建筑平面引导SDF优化，实现自适应多边形分配与清晰结构边界。
result: 在多个大规模无人机数据集上，SemLite-GS相较代表性全场景3DGS方法显著缩短建筑重建时间；在相当多边形预算下，其主导平面结构保持与建筑锐利过渡效果优于密集重建后网格简化流程。
conclusion: 该工作提出面向建筑轻量化重建的语义选择并行高斯泼溅框架，兼顾重建效率与结构保真度，并开源代码，具有城市三维建模应用潜力。

title: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. We then lift the resulting 2D tracklets to 3D Gaussians through a novel visibility voting strategy, yielding accurate 3D segmentation masks with clean object boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on LERF-OVS, ScanNet, and ScanNet++, competitive results on 3D-OVS, and significant speedups over existing open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework for efficient open-vocabulary 3D understanding without per-scene training.
tldr: 提出免训练查询驱动的Gaussian Splatting三维实例分割框架，实现高效开放词汇分割。
motivation: 开放词汇3D理解需定位并分割预定义类别之外的任意物体，但现有基于Gaussian Splatting的方法依赖昂贵预处理和冗长训练，难以满足快速、轻量需求。
method: 提出免训练的查询驱动3D实例分割框架：放弃mask-wise CLIP嵌入，改用稠密像素级CLIP特征保留细粒度语义并支持文本驱动定位；针对文本查询在精选pivot view中定位高质量目标区域，经视频分割器跨视角传播获得2D tracklets，再通过可见性投票策略提升为3D Gaussian掩码。
result: 在LERF-OVS、ScanNet和ScanNet++上取得SOTA，在3D-OVS上取得有竞争力结果，并较现有开放词汇3D分割方法显著加速；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作证明无需逐场景训练也能在Gaussian Splatting上实现高效、边界清晰的开放词汇3D实例分割，为轻量快速3D场景理解提供了新路线。

title: DEFDVO: Deformable Deep Visual Odometry for Equirectangular Images
abstract: Omnidirectional ($360^\circ$) cameras capture the full surrounding scene in every frame, providing a strong advantage for visual odometry (VO) over pinhole sensors with a limited field of view. However, their equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces latitude-dependent distortion, an artificial seam at the image border, and a sampling bias toward the poles. Existing $360^\circ$ VO methods address these challenges only partially. DEFDVO closes this gap with a patch-based deep VO method that operates directly on ERP imagery, combining spherically initialized deformable feature extraction, end-to-end seam-aware estimation, and spherical-gradient patch selection. The deformable feature extractor combines spherical geometric priors with learned sampling offsets, while seam-aware processing preserves ERP continuity, and spherical-gradient selection reduces polar sampling bias. Trained exclusively on synthetic TartanAirV2 ERP imagery, DEFDVO improves the best prior average absolute trajectory error (ATE) by $4.8\times$ (0.201 m to 0.042 m) on the TartanAirV2 evaluation set defined by 360DVO and achieves the lowest average ATE on both splits of the real-world 360DVO benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/BurakSevsay/DEFDVO
tldr: DEFDVO 提出面向 ERP 全景图像的块级深度视觉里程计，通过可变形特征与接缝感知显著降低轨迹误差。
motivation: 全景相机视场大，但 ERP 投影带来纬度相关畸变、图像边界接缝和极区采样偏置，现有 360° 视觉里程计方法只能部分解决这些问题。
method: DEFDVO 直接在 ERP 图像上执行基于图像块的深度视觉里程计：融合球面几何先验与可学习采样偏移的可变形特征提取，端到端接缝感知处理保持 ERP 连续性，并用球面梯度图像块选择缓解极区采样偏置。
result: 仅在合成 TartanAirV2 ERP 图像上训练，在 360DVO 定义的 TartanAirV2 评测集上将最佳先前方法的平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）从 0.201 m 降至 0.042 m，提升 4.8 倍；在真实世界 360DVO 基准的两个划分上均取得最低平均 ATE。
conclusion: 该方法补齐了 ERP 全景深度 VO 在畸变、接缝和极区偏置处理上的不足，在合成与真实基准上均优于现有方法，为 360° 视觉里程计提供了有效的端到端方案。

title: TetraCoder: Adaptive Tetrahedral Encoding for Neural Fields
abstract: Implicit and explicit representations of geometry are central in computer graphics applications and come with their pros and cons. With surface sampling being faster on explicit representations and spatial queries being faster on implicit representations, finding efficient conversions between them is a highly desirable property. We present TetraCoder, a single resolution hash-free adaptive tetrahedral encoding that links an explicit tetrahedral spatial encoder with an underlying implicit signed distance field (SDF). The resulting hybrid implicit-explicit space is continuous piecewise affine (CPWA) by design, allowing to obtain an exact correspondence between the implicit SDF and the explicit analytic mesh. TetraCoder's design comes with additional perks, in particular: (a) it scales better than multi-resolution encoding methods due to its single resolution optimizable grid, (b) unlike hash-based methods, it is not affected by collisions, (c) it enables fast tetrahedral ray-tracing, geometry and appearance editing, directly through its adaptive tetrahedral scaffold. We demonstrate the versatility of TetraCoder by showing an improvement over state-of-the-art methods on multiple tasks: 2D/3D fitting from images and point clouds, 3D novel view synthesis, 3D reconstruction, and geometry/appearance editing.
tldr: TetraCoder提出无哈希单分辨率自适应四面体编码，将显式四面体网格与隐式SDF精确关联，并在多类重建与编辑任务上优于现有方法。
motivation: 隐式与显式几何表示各有优劣：显式表示表面采样更快，隐式表示空间查询更快，因此需要高效且精确的相互转换。
method: TetraCoder采用单分辨率、无哈希的自适应四面体编码，将显式四面体空间编码器与底层隐式SDF关联，构造连续分段仿射（CPWA）的混合隐式-显式空间，从而在隐式SDF与显式解析网格间建立精确对应。
result: 摘要称在2D/3D图像与点云拟合、3D新视角合成、3D重建及几何/外观编辑等任务上相较SOTA均有提升，但未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该设计避免了多分辨率编码的扩展性问题和哈希碰撞问题，并支持快速四面体光线追踪及直接的几何/外观编辑，为神经场提供统一的隐式-显式表示。

title: Deep Bundle Adjustment
abstract: We present \textbf{DeepBA} (\textbf{Deep} \textbf{B}undle \textbf{A}djustment), a graph neural network (GNN) that recovers camera poses, intrinsics, and scene structure from 2D matches across an arbitrary number of views. Rather than solving a non-linear least-squares problem per scene, DeepBA amortizes bundle adjustment into a learned graph network that iteratively refines its estimate from geometric residuals. Where classical SfM computes its updates analytically and needs careful initialization, DeepBA learns them and converges from a cold start. It is trained with scale-invariant supervision (ground-truth rotation, translation direction, and intrinsics, plus reprojection self-consistency), so datasets with arbitrary metric units can be mixed without per-scene normalization. DeepBA is decoupled from the matcher. At 2.04M parameters, it outperforms prior learned SfM from matches on scene reconstruction and on most pose metrics, is competitive with classical SfM at moderate accuracy thresholds and overtakes it in wall time as the view count grows, and approaches monolithic image-to-geometry transformers such as VGGT ($\sim$1.2B parameters) with greater modularity. Project~page: https://cphjsn.github.io/deep-ba/
tldr: DeepBA 用图神经网络摊销光束法平差，从2D匹配冷启动恢复相机位姿、内参与场景结构。
motivation: 经典SfM需逐场景求解非线性最小二乘，依赖精细初始化；已有学习式SfM常与匹配器耦合。DeepBA旨在将BA摊销为可学习图网络，实现冷启动收敛并解耦匹配器。
method: DeepBA以GNN在任意数量视图的2D匹配上迭代优化几何残差，学习相机位姿、内参与场景结构的更新而非解析求解。训练采用尺度不变监督，包括真值旋转、平移方向、内参与重投影自一致性，使任意度量单位的数据集可混合训练。
result: 仅2.04M参数的DeepBA在场景重建和多数位姿指标上优于已有基于匹配的学习式SfM；在中等等精度阈值下与经典SfM相当，且视图数增加时墙钟时间反超。其性能接近约1.2B参数的VGGT等单体图像到几何Transformer，同时模块化更强。
conclusion: DeepBA表明学习式摊销BA可从冷启动收敛并保持匹配器无关的模块化优势，为可扩展SfM提供了轻量替代方案，并缩小了与大型单体几何Transformer的差距。

title: EcoVGGT: Pinned-Key Inference for Efficient and Streamable Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Long Videos
abstract: Feed-forward multi-view transformers such as VGGT recover the cameras and geometry of a video in one pass, but the cost of their cross-frame attention grows quadratically with the frame count, and their accuracy drops on long videos. Most remedies approximate attention over all frames within a budget or select a few keys by their content. We hypothesize that the keys of a long video can be chosen without looking at its content, and our experiments on VGGT and $π^3$ support it: a few dozen evenly spread frames can serve as the keys of every frame. We present EcoVGGT, a training-free inference framework whose keys form a Pinned Key Set of 31 such frames. A pin pass stores their tokens in a Scene Cache, and the other frames read it in independent batches that reproduce joint inference with these keys exactly, at a constant cost per frame. An Online Stream updates the pinned frames during recording. Six middle global blocks align the frames and form a reusable VGGT module: the Alignment Score reads their attention to flag failures, and Alignment Refocusing reduces them by fine-tuning only these blocks (3.6 GPU hours). EcoVGGT ($π^3$) matches the success rate of $π^3$ on 1,000-frame ScanNet videos at 13.8 times its speed. With refocusing, EcoVGGT (VGGT) raises the success rate of VGGT from 70% to 82% at 8.5 times its speed on 500 frames. EcoVGGT reconstructs 4,000 frames on one GPU, and EcoVGGT ($π^3$) streams 1,000 frames at 18.6 frames per second with the lowest online absolute trajectory error.
tldr: EcoVGGT用31帧固定关键集实现免训练、恒定单帧开销的长视频流式前馈三维重建。
motivation: VGGT等前馈多视图Transformer能一次恢复视频相机与几何，但跨帧注意力开销随帧数二次增长，且长视频精度下降；现有方法多通过预算内近似注意力或按内容挑选少量key来缓解。
method: 作者假设长视频的key无需查看内容即可选取，并在VGGT与π³上验证：均匀分布的几十帧可作为所有帧的key。EcoVGGT由此构建31帧Pinned Key Set，pin pass将其token存入Scene Cache，其余帧分批读取并以恒定单帧成本精确复现联合推理；Online Stream在录制中更新固定帧；6个中间global block组成可复用VGGT模块，Alignment Score读取其注意力以标记失败，Alignment Refocusing仅微调这些块（3.6 GPU小时）。
result: EcoVGGT（π³）在1000帧ScanNet视频上成功率与π³持平，速度提升13.8倍；经refocusing后，EcoVGGT（VGGT）在500帧上把VGGT成功率从70%提升到82%，速度提升8.5倍；单GPU可重建4000帧，EcoVGGT（π³）以18.6 FPS流式处理1000帧并取得最低在线绝对轨迹误差。
conclusion: EcoVGGT是一种免训练、可流式的前馈三维重建推理框架，以固定关键帧集和恒定单帧开销实现长视频高效重建，并通过轻量微调显著降低失败率、提升精度与可扩展性。

title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
abstract: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.
tldr: TelePhysica 通过闭环智能体重建可执行物理场景，并用模拟轨迹引导视频扩散生成。
motivation: 直接图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式运动耦合，无法维持持久3D力学平衡、支持中途干预和反事实力控；单次程序化3D重建又因单目深度与支撑间隙欠约束，导致场景穿插或重力坍塌。
method: 视觉语言编码智能体合成可分离视觉网格与声明式物理模型，并通过像素对齐轮廓评审和零力重力平衡预检两阶段验证；验证后的世界编译为统一求解器，耦合刚体、关节链、同维布料壳与3D四面体弹性动力学，模拟推演以像素对齐结构流条件化预训练视频扩散。
result: 在100场景单图基准上，闭环执行将平衡验证世界恢复率从单次合成的0%提升至81%；有限元布料相比刚性板代理产生一个数量级以上局部角位移和面外褶皱；模拟轨迹条件化使动态运动掩码重叠提升2–5倍，并在反事实力反转下保持运动方向，而直接图生视频模型失败。
conclusion: 结果表明，闭环物理重建、统一多物理求解与模拟轨迹条件化可生成可交互、力学一致且支持反事实控制的3D场景与视频，将单图重建推进为可执行物理世界并增强视频生成的物理可控性。

title: MacroGS: Macro-Pixel Shared Gaussian Primitives for Arbitrary-Scale Light Field Super-Resolutio
abstract: Arbitrary-scale light field spatial super-resolution reconstructs high-resolution views at any requested scale from low-resolution multi-view observations. Gaussian primitives enable continuous reconstruction, but generating separate primitive sets for each view redundantly encodes shared scene structure across views and causes the primitive count grow linearly with the number of views. To avoid such redundancy, we propose MacroGS, a feed-forward decoder that jointly predicts a single shared Gaussian set per macro pixel rather than generating separate sets for each view. Disparity-dependent replacement and angle-conditioned appearance allow each set to be reused across all output views, keeping the predicted primitive count independent of the number of views at each requested scale. The decoder iteratively predicts per-primitive disparities, retrieves the corresponding multi-view features, and updates the primitive states. Gaussian splatting and residual refinement then reconstruct the output light field. Despite being learned without geometric supervision, the predicted disparities strongly correlate with underlying scene geometry. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that MacroGS integrates effectively with diverse light field encoders, improving reconstruction quality at fixed scales while achieving leading performance across most evaluated arbitrary-scale settings. The decoder also achieves speedups of approximately $2$-$10\times$ over state-of-the-art implicit light field decoders and $10$-$18\times$ over the view-wise Gaussian baseline.
tldr: MacroGS 用逐宏像素共享的高斯基元实现任意尺度光场超分，减少视图冗余并加速重建。
motivation: 任意尺度光场空间超分需要从低分辨率多视图观测重建任意请求尺度的高分辨率视图。现有高斯基元方法虽支持连续重建，但为每个视图单独生成基元集合会冗余编码跨视图共享场景结构，并使基元数量随视图数线性增长。
method: 提出 MacroGS 前馈解码器，在每个宏像素上联合预测单个共享高斯集合，而非逐视图生成独立集合；通过视差相关替换和角度条件外观使该集合可复用于所有输出视图。解码器迭代预测逐基元视差、检索对应多视图特征并更新基元状态，随后用高斯泼溅与残差精修重建输出光场；尽管未使用几何监督，预测视差仍与场景几何强相关。
result: 在五个基准上，MacroGS 可与多种光场编码器有效集成，提升固定尺度重建质量，并在大多数任意尺度设置下取得领先性能；相比先进隐式光场解码器加速约 2-10 倍，相比逐视图高斯基线加速约 10-18 倍。
conclusion: MacroGS 通过宏像素共享高斯表示避免跨视图冗余，使每个请求尺度下的基元数量与视图数无关，为任意尺度光场超分提供了高效且兼容性强的解码方案。该方法在无几何监督下获得与场景几何相关的视差预测，显示出共享基元表示在光场重建中的潜力。

title: Stage-wise Lineage-aware Dropout for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is prone to overfitting because only a limited number of images are available to constrain scene geometry. Dropout is one regularization strategy for alleviating this problem. We introduce the concept of a lineage family to describe a set of Gaussian primitives derived from the same founder through cloning or splitting operations. The founder Gaussians refer to all Gaussian primitives generated during initialization. Descendants within the same family often jointly contribute to the refinement of adjacent local regions. However, dropping individual Gaussians can be less effective due to the compensation effect from neighboring Gaussians for the dropped ones. To address this issue, we propose Stage-wise Lineage-aware Dropout(SLD), which applies lineage-family dropout during the structural regularization stage and switches to individual dropout during the later refinement stage. We further propose Lineage-Balanced Densification(LBD), which operates during densification by constructing an expanded candidate pool and reallocating the densification budget according to the mean gradient scores and existing descendant sizes of different families. Experiments on the LLFF, MipNeRF360, and Blender datasets show that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance in sparse-view reconstruction
tldr: 提出阶段式谱系感知Dropout与谱系平衡致密化，缓解稀疏视角3DGS过拟合。
motivation: 稀疏视角3DGS因可用图像有限、场景几何约束不足而容易过拟合。现有Dropout正则化中，单独丢弃高斯因邻近高斯的补偿作用而效果有限，需要针对同一谱系内高斯的联合贡献进行建模。
method: 定义由同一创始高斯经克隆或分裂得到的谱系家族；提出SLD，在结构正则化阶段执行谱系家族级Dropout，在后续细化阶段切换为个体Dropout；并提出LBD，在致密化时构建扩展候选池，依据不同家族的平均梯度分数和已有后代规模重新分配致密化预算。
result: 在LLFF、MipNeRF360和Blender数据集上的实验表明，该框架在稀疏视角重建中取得有竞争力的性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作通过谱系感知的阶段式Dropout和谱系平衡致密化，为稀疏视角3DGS提供了一种针对过拟合与致密化不均衡的正则化框架。其贡献有望提升稀疏输入下三维重建的稳定性与质量。

title: X-Strata: Separating Aneurysms and Overlapping Vessels into Layers from 2D X-ray Angiography
abstract: An X-ray angiogram sums every structure along a ray into one pixel. When vessels cross an aneurysm, they obscure part of it and mix their contrast into its filling curve. We present X-Strata, a network that separates a cine angiogram into three layers: the complete aneurysm sac, the vessels in front of it, and the vessels behind it. Contrast timing indicates how much each layer contributes to a pixel, and parallax between two views indicates their order, which a single view cannot determine. X-Strata first estimates the layers and their contrast curves, then uses the second view to assign vessels to the front or back layer, and lifts all layers into 3D. It learns from layer labels projected from same-session 3D rotational angiography, but needs only 2D cine runs and their acquisition geometry at inference. On 220 held-out patients from three centers (122 external), two-view X-Strata ranks first among 14 baselines, including VGGT and C$^2$RV, in recovering the sac where vessels overlap it (Dice 0.693 internal, 0.641 external) and in ordering the layers (balanced accuracy 0.703, 0.659). Its order accuracy exceeds that of all 11 end-to-end baselines by at least 4.1 points internally and 3.3 externally (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$) and grows with view separation. Recovered 3D sac surfaces have a median Chamfer distance of 0.34 mm on the internal cohort. X-Strata may therefore provide layered aneurysm and vessel information, including 3D sac shape, for patients who undergo only 2D angiography.
tldr: X-Strata 利用双视角造影将动脉瘤与前后血管分层并重建3D瘤囊。
motivation: 2D X 射线血管造影将沿射线方向的所有结构叠加到同一像素，交叉血管会遮挡动脉瘤并将其对比剂混入瘤囊充盈曲线，且单视角无法判断血管位于瘤囊前方还是后方。研究目标是分离动脉瘤囊与重叠血管层，并恢复其空间层次和三维形态。
method: X-Strata 首先从 cine angiogram 估计动脉瘤囊、前方血管和后方血管三层及其对比曲线，再利用第二视角的视差将血管分配到前层或后层，并将各层提升到3D。训练时使用同次3D旋转血管造影投影得到的层标签，推理时仅需2D cine 序列及其采集几何。
result: 在三中心220例留出患者（122例外中心）上，双视角X-Strata在血管重叠区域恢复瘤囊（Dice 0.693内部、0.641外部）和层排序（平衡准确率0.703、0.659）方面于14个基线中排名第一，包括VGGT和C²RV；其层序准确率至少比11个端到端基线高4.1个百分点（内部）和3.3个百分点（外部），Holm校正p<0.001，并随视角间隔增大而提升。内部队列恢复的3D瘤囊表面中位Chamfer距离为0.34 mm。
conclusion: X-Strata 能为仅接受2D血管造影的患者提供分层的动脉瘤与血管信息，包括3D瘤囊形状，有望扩展2D造影在动脉瘤评估中的信息利用能力。

title: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View 3D Transformers via Regime-Aware Attention Approximation
abstract: Multi-view 3D transformers such as VGGT reconstruct a scene from a set of unposed images in a single forward pass, predicting camera poses, depth and 3D points, but the cost of their global attention grows quadratically with the num- ber of images. Accelerators borrowed from large language models assume that each token attends to only a few oth- ers; on these models they lose accuracy or gain little speed. We study the global attention of three multi-view transform- ers on seven datasets and find that every layer plays one of three roles: it averages over the whole scene, matches points across many images, or anchors on the first image, whose coordinates the outputs use. Building on this anal- ysis, we propose Regime-AWare ATTention Approximation (RAWATTA), a training-free method that runs attention in 8- bit precision and keeps 16-bit precision only in the layers where a worst-case calibration check requires it. Its fast set- ting, RAWATTA-Fast, also approximates attention in a few averaging and anchoring layers, while matching layers and the first image keep all their keys. On a 12 GB GPU at 50 im- ages, RAWATTA runs VGGT faster than the released code, mostly through our CUDA engine, and loses at most about one point of pose accuracy (AUC@3) on any dataset; RAWATTA-Fast is slightly faster and less accurate. Both fit 200 images, where the released code runs out of memory at 100.
tldr: 提出免训练RAWATTA，按注意力角色混合8/16位近似，加速多视图3D Transformer并支持200图。
motivation: 多视图3D Transformer（如VGGT）的全局注意力随图像数量二次增长，而借用自大语言模型的稀疏注意力加速器在此类模型上要么掉精度要么提速有限。本文旨在免训练地降低该全局注意力开销，同时保持位姿、深度和3D点预测精度。
method: 作者在7个数据集上分析三个多视图Transformer的全局注意力，发现每层承担整场景平均、跨图像点匹配或首图锚定三类角色之一。据此提出RAWATTA：以8位精度运行注意力，仅在最坏情况校准检查要求时保留16位；RAWATTA-Fast进一步在平均与锚定层做近似，而匹配层和首图保留全部key，并用CUDA引擎加速。
result: 在12 GB GPU、50张图像下，RAWATTA比官方代码更快（主要得益于CUDA引擎），在任一数据集上位姿精度AUC@3最多下降约1个点；RAWATTA-Fast略快但精度更低。两者可处理200张图像，而官方代码在100张时已显存不足。
conclusion: 研究表明按注意力角色进行混合精度与结构化近似可在免训练条件下有效加速多视图3D Transformer，并显著扩展可处理图像数量。该方法为高分辨率、大场景多视图3D重建提供了实用加速路径，并提示LLM式稀疏加速需适配3D注意力的层角色。

title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
abstract: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/
tldr: BrickFlow通过集合条件SE(3)流模型与连通性场引导，从图像和零件集重建可组装的LEGO结构。
motivation: 给定LEGO零件集与组装物体图像，需推断每个零件的位姿并完成组装。该任务需满足离散物理约束，问题具有组合性且对微小位姿误差高度敏感，传统3D重建难以直接适用。
method: 在程序生成的装配体上训练set-conditioned SE(3) flow model，学习零件如何拼合的先验；再用仅1%的数据微调以注入图像条件；测试时引入解析的connectivity-field guidance，将预测拉向连通的装配体。
result: 实验表明，构建质量随模型规模、预训练和连通性引导的使用而提升；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法将学习到的SE(3)流先验与解析连通性引导结合，改善了基于图像的LEGO装配重建质量，并公开模型与数据以促进后续研究。

title: Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model
abstract: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.
tldr: Kosmo-GFM 整合几何基础模型、位姿优化引擎与重建监督，实现高精度高效场景重建。
motivation: 针对场景级三维/四维重建中相机位姿与几何恢复的精度和效率难题，论文提出可生产部署的几何基础模型系统，旨在用学习到的几何先验增强重建流程。
method: GFM 从图像/视频预测相机参数、深度、跨视角对应和动态三维点；PoseEngine 将这些预测与几何优化结合，恢复场景级相机位姿与几何，供 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting 使用；KosmoWorld 从重建的真实场景生成图像与几何监督，反向提升 GFM 的几何预测。
result: 在 SpatialBench 的 Sparse 和 Medium 子集上，GFM 取得最低绝对相对深度误差和最高 5° 相对位姿 AUC；在五个数据集上取得最低动态点与场景流平均端点误差。34 个场景中 PoseEngine 在 1°/3°/5° 阈值下场景平均位姿 AUC 最高，累计运行 14.07 小时，约为 GLUEMAP 69.67 小时的 20%；PoseEngine Flash 混合精度运行 2.62 小时，约为其 4%。
conclusion: 结果表明学习几何先验可用于场景级重建流水线，并在精度与效率间取得优势；系统具备生产可用性，对 3D/4D 重建与 Gaussian Splatting 下游任务有潜在影响。

title: Reconstruct What You Can: Distractor-free 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Dynamic reconstruction from casual video must preserve valid subject motion while suppressing transient occluders, shadows, and volumetric effects. Existing methods either suppress valid motion through static-scene assumptions or model all observations jointly, producing ghosting and unstable geometry. We introduce ReCan-GS, a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework that separates coherent scene content from inconsistent observations. It derives a Jacobian-based deformation-sensitivity score from the learned deformation field, using it as an empirical proxy for reconstruction ambiguity. The score guides separation into dynamic Core Gaussians and per-view Distractor Gaussians, or post-hoc pruning of sensitive Core Gaussians. The same criterion supports removal of spatial occluders, photometric artifacts, and evolving smoke or fog without masks, pretrained segmenters, or medium-specific supervision. Experiments on synthetic and real dynamic scenes and synthetic smoke/fog scenes demonstrate its usefulness across the evaluated distractor regimes.
tldr: ReCan-GS利用形变敏感度分离动态核心与干扰高斯，实现无掩码的干扰物去除4D重建。
motivation: 随意视频的动态重建需保留有效主体运动，同时抑制瞬态遮挡、阴影和体积效应。现有方法要么以静态场景假设压制有效运动，要么联合建模所有观测，导致鬼影和几何不稳定。
method: 提出ReCan-GS 4D高斯泼溅框架，从学习到的形变场推导基于Jacobian的形变敏感度分数，作为重建歧义的经验代理。该分数指导将场景分离为动态Core Gaussians与逐视图Distractor Gaussians，或对敏感Core Gaussians进行事后剪枝；同一准则无需掩码、预训练分割器或介质特定监督即可去除空间遮挡、光度伪影及演化烟雾/雾。
result: 在合成与真实动态场景以及合成烟雾/雾场景上的实验表明，该方法在所评估的干扰物情形下具有有效性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: ReCan-GS通过形变敏感度统一分离一致场景内容与不一致观测，为无需额外掩码和预训练分割器的鲁棒4D重建提供了新思路。其潜在影响在于提升随意视频动态重建对多种干扰物的适应性与几何稳定性。

title: GOOSELoc: A Multimodal Benchmark for Ground-to-Aerial Localization in Unstructured Off-Road Terrain
abstract: Cross-view pose estimation estimates a ground camera's geographic pose by matching onboard sensor data with geo-referenced overhead imagery. This is particularly relevant when GNSS is unreliable, for example under forest canopy or in urban canyons. Existing metric cross-view benchmarks, such as VIGOR and cross-view KITTI, are dominated by urban and road scenes with strong human-made structure without off-road terrain. We introduce GOOSELoc, a multimodal benchmark for ground-to-aerial localization in unstructured environments, including forests, fields, and rural tracks. GOOSELoc comprises 9,356 scenes recorded across all four seasons around Munich, Germany, pairing geo-referenced aerial orthophotos with surround-view RGB imagery and 3D LiDAR point clouds. Paved/unpaved labels enable analyzing the impact of terrain structure, while the seasonal recordings allow studying the appearance gap to mostly summer-captured orthophotos. To assess the transferability of existing methods, we adapt and fine-tune four state-of-the-art cross-view localization baselines on GOOSELoc. Despite task-specific fine-tuning, the performance degrades substantially in off-road environments. We therefore propose a multimodal baseline combining surround-view imagery and LiDAR geometry, improving localization performance and providing a stronger reference for future work. Data and baselines are released at https://gooseloc.github.io.
tldr: 提出GOOSELoc非结构化越野地面到空中定位多模态基准，并给出融合环视RGB与LiDAR的基线。
motivation: 现有度量跨视角定位基准多集中于城市和道路等强人造结构场景，缺乏森林、田野和乡村小径等非结构化越野环境；在GNSS不可靠时，此类环境的地面到空中定位需求突出。
method: 构建GOOSELoc基准，包含德国慕尼黑周边四季录制的9,356个场景，配对地理参考航拍正射影像、环视RGB图像和3D LiDAR点云，并提供铺装/非铺装标签以分析地形结构影响及季节外观差异。适配并微调四种先进跨视角定位基线，同时提出融合环视图像与LiDAR几何的多模态基线。
result: 摘要给出9,356个场景、四季覆盖及四种基线微调结果；现有方法即便任务特定微调后在越野环境中性能仍显著下降，所提多模态基线提升定位性能，但未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GOOSELoc补充了非结构化越野地面到空中定位基准，揭示现有方法迁移性不足，并提供更强的多模态参考基线；数据和基线已公开，有望推动鲁棒跨视角定位研究。
